sources.title: CRA — Cyber Resilience Act (products with digital elements)
sources.why: Requires mHealth software to be secure by design and by default, the core of storage and security obligations.

sources.title: HDS — Health Data Host certification (France)
sources.why: Mandates certified, secure hosting for storing French patients' health data, directly governing storage security.

sources.title: GDPR Chapter V — international transfers
sources.why: Requires encryption and safeguards when health data is stored on non-EU cloud regions.
